candidates.title: The drained public pool
candidates.concept: During the emptying of a municipal swimming pool, a woman descends the shallow-end steps and finds a vast unfamiliar living structure folded through the deep end. Its local scale is readable against pool lanes while the same continuous body extends into a black vertical distance where the rear wall should be. The person is the only creature trying to understand the encounter.
candidates.reason: The pool supplies ordinary measured human scale and a simple foreground-to-background route; a biological presence makes the encounter different from empty liminal architecture.

candidates.title: The glacier bore chamber
candidates.concept: A woman returning a drill sample to a glacier bore chamber discovers a nonhuman organism filling the transparent ice immediately beyond the cut wall. Long ordered tissues continue through ancient ice far beyond the small chamber. Her suspended hand and the organism's indifferent repetition carry the encounter.
candidates.reason: A small practical human task meets deep time, through an intelligible physical viewing boundary.

candidates.title: The freight elevator threshold
candidates.concept: A woman waits with a folded trolley outside an old municipal freight elevator; the open doors reveal the inside of a colossal living chamber whose repeated internal organs continue far beyond the building's width. She remains at the threshold while the entity's subtle breath bends the hanging elevator light.
candidates.reason: A familiar door gives the encounter a clean boundary and a body-sized scale reference while the spatial extent contradicts the ordinary building.
